paragraphs: Archer-Daniels-Midland Company and its subsidiaries (the "Company" or "ADM") unlocks the power of nature to enrich the quality of life. The Company is an essential global agricultural supply chain manager and processor, providing food security by connecting local needs with global capabilities. ADM is also a premier human and animal nutrition provider, as well as a leader in health and well-being products.

The Company partners with thousands of farmers around the world to purchase their crops and uses its integrated global origination, logistics, and manufacturing network to transform many of those raw commodities into an expansive array of products serving the food, feed, fuel, and industrial and consumer products sectors. The Company offers a broad portfolio of food and beverage products, from staple foods to innovative alternatives, such as natural colors and flavors, plant-based proteins, and lower-sugar, fat, and salt solutions. ADM provides human and animal nutrition ingredients and solutions that support health, productivity, and sustainability. It offers a wide range of health and well-being products, such as probiotics, enzymes, and supplements to meet the needs of consumers looking for new ways to live healthier lives. ADM is a key producer of biofuels, converting agricultural feedstocks into renewable fuels used in transportation and industrial applications. ADM is a cutting-edge innovator, investing in research, application development, and process improvement to deliver value-added products, enhance supply chain efficiency, and advance sustainable agricultural and nutrition solutions. It continues to develop a broad range of new bio-based consumer and industrial solutions as well as advance and scale its carbon capture and sequestration capabilities and other initiatives. ADM is a leader in business-driven sustainability efforts that support a strong agricultural sector, resilient supply chains, and a vast and growing bioeconomy. Around the globe, ADM's expertise and innovation are meeting critical needs from harvest to home.

ADM also has significant investments in certain entities and joint venture arrangements that aim to expand or enhance the market for its products or offer other benefits including, but not limited to, geographic or product-line expansion.

The Company's operations are organized, managed, and classified into three reportable segments: Ag Services and Oilseeds, Carbohydrate Solutions, and Nutrition. Each of these segments is organized based upon the nature of products and services offered. The Company's remaining operations are not reportable segments, as defined by the applicable accounting standard, and are classified within either Corporate or Other Business. Financial information with respect to the Company's reportable segments is set forth in Part II. Item 8. Note 17. Segment and Geographic Information.

The Ag Services and Oilseeds segment includes global activities related to the origination, merchandising, transportation, and storage of agricultural raw materials, as well as the crushing and processing of oilseeds, including soybeans and soft seeds such as cottonseed, sunflower seed, canola, rapeseed, and flaxseed. The segment produces and markets vegetable oils and oilseed protein meals used by food, feed, energy, and industrial customers. Crude and partially refined vegetable oils are sold to third parties, including renewable diesel manufacturers, or further processed into salad oils, margarine, shortening, biodiesel, glycols, and other food and industrial products. Oilseed protein meals are primarily sold as ingredients for commercial livestock and poultry feeds. The segment is also a major supplier of peanuts and peanut‑derived ingredients and manufactures cotton cellulose pulp in North America for chemical, paper, and other industrial markets. In addition, its integrated grain sourcing, handling, and multimodal transportation network supports global import, export, and distribution activities and provides essential services to customers and the Company's processing operations. The Company also engages in various structured trade finance activities through this segment to leverage its global trade flows.

The Company has a 22.5% equity interest in Wilmar International Limited ("Wilmar"), a Singapore publicly listed company. Wilmar is a leading global agribusiness group headquartered in Asia engaged in the businesses of packaged oils and packaged foods, oil palm cultivation, oilseeds crushing, edible oils refining, sugar milling and refining, specialty fats, oleo chemicals, biodiesel and fertilizers manufacturing, and grains processing.

The Company also has equity interests in the following entities that engage in activities that fall within the Ag Services and Oilseeds segment: Pacificor, SoyVen Holding B.V., Olenex Holdings B.V., Edible Oils Limited, Stratas Foods LLC, Terminal de Grãos Ponta da Montanha S.A., Gradable, LLC, and Plainsman Company, LLC.
The Company is a supplier of raw materials to Wilmar, SoyVen, Olenex Sarl, Edible Oils Limited, and Stratas Foods LLC.

The Carbohydrate Solutions segment engages in corn and wheat wet and dry milling and related processing activities. The segment converts corn and wheat into products and ingredients used in food and beverage applications, including sweeteners, starches, syrups, glucose, wheat flour, and dextrose. Dextrose and starches are also utilized as feedstocks in downstream processes, including fermentation to produce alcohol and other food and animal feed ingredients. Ethanol is produced for use as an octane enhancer and oxygenate in gasoline. In addition, the segment produces distillers' grains, corn gluten feed, and corn gluten meal for use as animal feed ingredients. Corn germ, a by‑product of wet milling, is further processed into vegetable oil and protein meal, and citric acids are produced for food and industrial applications. The Carbohydrate Solutions segment also advances carbon capture and sequestration and other emissions‑reduction initiatives, positioning the business to support lower‑carbon operations and the growing use of plant‑based alternatives to fossil‑derived materials.

The Company has equity interests in the following entities that engage in activities that fall within the Carbohydrate Solutions segment: Hungrana Ltd, Almidones Mexicanos S.A. de CV, Aston Foods and Food Ingredients, Red Star Yeast Company, LLC, and LSCP, LLC.

The Nutrition segment serves various end markets including food, beverages, and nutritional supplements for humans, and complete feed, feed premix and additives, pet food and pet treats for livestock, aquaculture, and pets. The segment engages in the creation, manufacturing, sale, and distribution of a wide array of ingredients and solutions including plant-based proteins, flavors and colors derived from nature, flavor systems, emulsifiers, soluble fiber, polyols, hydrocolloids, probiotics, prebiotics, postbiotics, enzymes, botanical extracts, and other specialty food and feed ingredients and systems. The Nutrition segment also includes activities related to the procurement, processing, and distribution of edible beans, the processing and distribution of formula feeds and animal health and nutrition products and the manufacture of contract and private label pet treats and foods.

The Company has equity interests in the following entities that engage in activities that fall within the Nutrition segment: Vimison S.A. de C.V., Vitafort ZRT, Dusial S.A., Novial SAS, ADM Matsutani LLC and Matsutani Singapore Pte. Ltd.

Corporate includes the activities related to cost and equity method investments in early-stage start-up companies within ADM Ventures. In addition to identifying companies to invest in, ADM Ventures also works on select high-potential, new product development projects and alternative business models, all with the objective of supporting the Company's strategic objectives.
Other Business includes the Company's remaining operations as described below.

headings: The Company is exposed to potential business disruption risks which could adversely affect the Company's operating results and could result in increased expenses and liabilities.
Transportation, inflationary impacts, and fluctuations in energy prices could affect the Company's operating results.
Human capital availability may not be sufficient to effectively support global operations.
The Company may fail to realize the benefits of or experience delays in the execution of its strategic priorities.
The Company faces risks related to health epidemics, pandemics, and similar outbreaks.

The Company faces risks related to international conflicts, acts of terrorism, war, other geopolitical events, such as the ongoing Russia-Ukraine conflict, maritime piracy, and other economic disruptions.
Geopolitical risks could disrupt global markets and negatively impact the Company's business and financial results.

The Company is subject to various evolving regulations related to ESG matters which impacts the Company's business and strategies, and could adversely affect its reputation, business and results of operations.
The Company's goals and stakeholder expectations relating to ESG-related matters and sustainable practices may expose the Company to increased costs, reputational harm and other risks.
Limitations on access to external financing could adversely affect the Company's operating results due to its capital-intensive nature.
The Company is subject to risks relating to global and regional economic downturns, which could adversely affect the Company's operating results.
The Company has significant competition in the markets in which it operates and is subject to industry-specific risks which could adversely affect the Company's operating results.
The Company's risk management strategies may not be effective.
The Company is subject to numerous laws, regulations, and mandates globally which could adversely affect the Company's operating results and forward strategy.
Changes in tax laws or exposure to additional tax liabilities could have a material impact on the Company's financial condition and results of operations.

The Company's inability to successfully upgrade its information and operational technology systems could have a material and adverse effect on the Company's business, financial condition, and operational results.
Information and operational technology systems are subject to interruptions or failures which may affect the Company's ability to conduct its business.
The Company's systems, processes, and sites are subject to cybersecurity and other incidents, which could expose the Company to operational and various regulatory risks.
The Company is subject to various technical, legal, and opportunistic-related risks relating to use of artificial intelligence and other emerging digital technologies.
The Company is involved in a number of legal proceedings that may result in adverse outcomes.
Negative publicity has in the past and in the future may adversely affect the Company and the market price of its common stock.
paragraphs: The risks described below, as well as the other information contained in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, should be carefully considered. Any one or more of such risks could materially and adversely affect the Company's business, financial condition, results of operations, and stock price and could cause actual results of operations and financial condition to vary materially from past or anticipated future results of operations and financial condition. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to the Company or that the Company currently believes to be immaterial may also adversely affect the Company.

The Company engages in manufacturing and distribution activities across numerous markets and geographies. As a result, the Company is subject to risks inherent in such activities and from time to time has experienced unplanned downtime or extensive property damage and business disruption from various events and external factors, some of which are beyond the Company's control. These events and factors include, but are not limited to, equipment failure, raw material shortages, natural disasters, adverse weather conditions, accidents, explosions, fires, environmental events, strikes or other labor or industrial disputes, war or acts of terrorism, cybersecurity attacks, or other unexpected outages. These events could result in personal injury, loss of life, and environmental damage. In some cases, the Company is dependent on a single plant or facility to manufacture or process certain products in a geographical region or otherwise. The Company may not be able to resolve disruptions timely or effectively, and the associated liability which could result from these risks may not always be covered by or could exceed liability insurance, and any insurance proceeds may not be received for several years after an event occurrence. The impact of these events and factors has and could in the future require significant investments and expenditures to repair damaged facilities or equipment and require management attention and other resources, which has and could adversely impact the Company's results of operations.

The Company's operations rely on dependable and efficient transportation services, the disruption of which could result in difficulties supplying materials to the Company's facilities and impair the Company's ability to deliver products to its customers in a timely manner. The Company relies on access to navigable rivers and waterways in order to fulfill its transportation obligations more effectively. In addition, if certain non-agricultural commodity raw materials, such as water or certain chemicals used in the Company's processing operations, are not available, the Company's business could be disrupted. Any major lack of available water for use in certain of the Company's processing operations could have a material adverse impact on operating results. Certain factors which may impact the availability of non-agricultural commodity raw materials are out of the Company's control including, but not limited to, disruptions resulting from weather, high or low river water conditions, economic conditions, border closures, manufacturing delays or disruptions at suppliers, shortage of materials, interruption of energy supply, and unavailable or poor supplier credit conditions.

The Company's operating costs and the selling prices of certain finished products are sensitive to changes in energy prices, inflationary pressures, and certain logistic constraints. The Company's processing plants are powered principally by electricity, natural gas, and coal. The Company's transportation operations are partially dependent upon rail access, diesel fuel and other petroleum-based products, as well as on the availability and cost of ocean freight and port operations. Significant increases in the cost or access of these items, including any consequences of inflationary impacts, regulation or taxation of greenhouse gases, has and could in the future adversely affect the Company's production costs and operating results.

ADM's global operations function with skilled individuals necessary for the processing, warehousing, and shipping of raw materials for products used in other areas of manufacturing or sold as inputs or products to third-party customers. The availability of skilled trade and production workers has been a specific focus for the manufacturing industry. The inability to properly staff manufacturing facilities with skilled trades and hourly labor due to a limited number of qualified resources could negatively impact operations.

As part of its broader strategy, the Company is focused on operational excellence and driving targeted cost reductions. The Company has implemented plans to improve the performance of its manufacturing and production facilities, increase operating leverage within the Nutrition segment, and reduce third party spend and selling, general, and administrative expenses. The success of these plans, and any future related plans, depend on a broad range of factors. The Company's ability to improve its cost structure depends on reducing its manufacturing, delivery and administrative costs, as well as having cost-effective purchasing programs for raw materials, energy and related manufacturing requirements, all of which are subject to risks and uncertainties and may not be successful. The Company's working capital requirements are directly affected by the price of global commodities, which may fluctuate significantly and change quickly. The implementation of these plans may be more difficult, costly, or time-consuming than expected, and may not result in any or all of the anticipated benefits, which could adversely affect the Company's business, results of operations and financial condition.

paragraphs: This Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations (MD&A) should be read in conjunction with the accompanying Consolidated Financial Statements, which can be found in Part II. Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data.

This MD&A generally discusses 2025 and 2024 items and year-to-year comparisons between 2025 and 2024. Discussions of 2023 items and year-to-year comparisons between 2024 and 2023 are not included in this Form 10-K and can be found in "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" in Part II. Item 7 of the Company's Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, filed on February 20, 2025.

Archer-Daniels-Midland Company and its subsidiaries (the "Company" or "ADM") unlocks the power of nature to enrich the quality of life. The Company is an essential global agricultural supply chain manager and processor, providing food security by connecting local needs with global capabilities. ADM is also a premier human and animal nutrition provider, as well as a leader in health and well-being products.

The Company's operations are organized, managed, and classified into three reportable segments: Ag Services and Oilseeds, Carbohydrate Solutions, and Nutrition. The Company's remaining operations are not reportable segments, as defined by the applicable accounting standard, and are classified within either Corporate or Other Business. See Part II. Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data. Note 17. Segment and Geographic Information for further information on the nature of our business and our reportable segments.
The Company's goal is to continue to build and sustain long-term value for its shareholders and customers. The Company has established the following priorities to help achieve its goal:

•Focus on execution and cost management – ADM seeks to prioritize operational excellence and drive targeted cost reductions through: (1) boosting plant efficiencies; (2) optimizing operating leverage within the Nutrition segment; and (3) reducing third party spend and selling, general, and administrative expenses.

•Strategic simplification – ADM seeks to enhance returns on invested capital by executing a pipeline of simplification opportunities to optimize our portfolio and organizational structure, including: (1) addressing performance, demand, and capacity challenges; (2) reducing capital expenditures that do not meet the Company's return objectives; and (3) reducing capability overlaps through synergies, closures, and divestitures.

•Targeted growth investment – ADM seeks to prioritize organic investment in key strategic initiatives, while also ensuring our businesses are ready for the future, including: (1) plant modernization investments; (2) cost optimization investments; and (3) enterprise system and process enhancements.
•Deploy capital with discipline – ADM seeks to prudently invest in opportunities while continuing to return value to shareholders through dividends.

The successful execution of the above priorities is expected to afford ADM the ability to continue investing in future growth that creates value over the long-term. ADM is investing in several key areas such as enhanced nutrition, biotics, biosolutions, precision fermentation, and decarbonization. Each of these development pathways has a different growth profile and timeline for value creation, and each complements our core business and presents the potential for compelling, enduring returns.
ARCHER-DANIELS-MIDLAND COMPANY MANAGEMENT'S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS OF FINANCIAL CONDITION AND RESULTS OF OPERATIONS

ADM has refined its digital strategy and has pivoted away from large global implementations and toward prioritizing regional, more agile projects. The Company is accelerating its data journey while continuing to invest in cybersecurity and network and application resilience. As a result of this strategy refinement, during the year ended December 31, 2025, the Company recognized an impairment charge of $179 million related to previously capitalized internal-use software. See Part II. Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data. Note 18. Asset Impairment, Exit, and Restructuring Costs for further information.

For more than 120 years, ADM has built its business on the strength of agriculture, innovation, and responsible stewardship. Today, sustainability is a core driver of ADM's growth strategy, powering innovation, improving resilience, and unlocking new value across the global food system. The crops that ADM turns into an expansive array of products depend on healthy soil, water and air, and as the Company looks to the future, it is advancing efforts that enable and support agriculture and farmers, drive innovation and long-term value, and protect and strengthen vital supply chains.

ADM is focused on scaling regenerative practices in partnership with farmers, supporting them with tools, insights, and financial incentives to help their operations thrive. ADM is innovating to meet growing demand for sustainably sourced, bio-based products, creating new market opportunities for farmers whose crops deliver health, transparency, and environmental benefits. The Company is modernizing its own operations to improve efficiency, enhance competitiveness, reduce emissions, and help build a more resilient supply chain.

paragraphs: Archer-Daniels-Midland Company 以及其子公司（the "Company" 或 "ADM"）發揮自然的力量，提升生活品質。本公司為全球重要的農業供應鏈管理與加工企業，透過連結當地需求與全球能力，提供糧食安全。ADM 同時也是人與動物營養的首選供應商，並在健康與 wellness 產品領域為領導者。

本公司與全球數千位農民合作，購買其農產品，並運用其整合的全球採購、物流與製造網路，將許多原始農產品轉化為服務食品、飼料、燃料以及工業與消費產品領域的廣泛產品。本公司提供多樣化的食品與飲料產品，從基本糧食到創新替代品，例如天然色素與風味、植物基蛋白質以及低糖、低脂肪與低鹽解決方案。ADM 提供人與動物營養原料與解決方案，支持健康、生產力與永續性。本公司提供廣泛的健康與 wellness 產品，例如益生菌、酵素與補充品，以滿足消費者追求更健康生活的需求。ADM 是生物燃料的主要生產者，將農業原料轉化為用於運輸與工業應用的可再生能源。ADM 是先進的創新者，投資於研究、應用開發與流程改進，以提供附加價值產品、提升供應鏈效率，並推動永續農業與營養解決方案。本公司持續開發廣泛的生物基消費與工業解決方案，並推進與擴大其碳捕捉與封存能力及其他計畫。ADM 在以商業為導向的永續性努力中為領導者，支持強大的農業部門、韌性供應鏈以及廣大且成長中的生物經濟。在全球範圍內，ADM 的專業知識與創新正在從收穫到家庭之間解決關鍵需求。
ADM 也在某些企業與合資企業中擁有重大投資，這些投資旨在擴展或提升其產品市場，或提供其他好處，包括但不限於地理或產品線的擴張。
本公司的業務運作、管理與分類為三個應報告分部：農業服務與油籽、碳水化合物解決方案與營養。這些分部依其提供的產品與服務性質進行組織。本公司的其他業務運作不屬於應報告分部，根據適用的會計準則，並歸類於企業本部或其他業務。關於本公司應報告分部的財務資訊，請參閱第二部分第 8 項。附註 17。分部與地理資訊。

農業服務與油籽分部包括全球與農業原始材料的採購、貿易、運輸與儲存相關活動，以及油籽（包括大豆與軟籽如棉花籽、向日葵籽、芥花籽、亞麻籽等）的壓榨與加工。該分部生產並銷售用於食品、飼料、能源與工業客戶的植物油與油籽蛋白飼料。未經處理或部分處理的植物油銷售給第三方，包括可再生柴油製造商，或進一步加工為沙拉油、起司油、酥油、生物柴油、甘醇及其他食品與工業產品。油籽蛋白飼料主要銷售為商業牲畜與禽類飼料原料。該分部同時也是花生與花生衍生原料的主要供應商，並在北美製造棉花纖維紙漿，供應化學、紙張及其他工業市場。此外，其整合的穀物採購、處理與多模式運輸網路支持全球進口、出口與分銷活動，並為客戶與本公司的加工業務提供必要服務。本公司也透過此分部進行各種結構化貿易金融活動，以利用其全球貿易流量。
本公司持有 Wilmar International Limited（"Wilmar"），一間新加坡上市公司的 22.5% 股權。Wilmar 是一家以亞洲為總部的全球農業企業集團，從事包裝油與包裝食品、油棕種植、油籽壓榨、食用油精煉、糖製造與精煉、特殊脂肪、油脂化學品、生物柴油與肥料製造，以及穀物加工等業務。

本公司也持有以下企業的股權，這些企業從事的業務屬於農業服務與油籽分部：Pacificor、SoyVen Holding B.V.、Olenex Holdings B.V.、Edible Oils Limited、Stratas Foods LLC、Terminal de Grãos Ponta da Montanha S.A.、Gradable, LLC 以及 Plainsman Company, LLC。
本公司為 Wilmar、SoyVen、Olen, Sarl、Edible Oils Limited 以及 Stratas Foods LLC 提供原料。

Carbohydrate Solutions 業務單位從事玉米與小麥的濕法與乾法製造及相關加工活動。該業務單位將玉米與小麥轉化為用於食品與飲料應用的產品與原料，包括甜味劑、澱粉、糖漿、葡萄糖、小麥麵粉與右旋糖。右旋糖與澱粉也用作下游製程的原料，包括發酵製造酒精及其他食品與動物飼料原料。酒精用作汽油的辛烷值增強劑與氧氣添加劑。此外，該業務單位製造酒精廠殘渣、玉米蛋白飼料與玉米蛋白粉，用作動物飼料原料。玉米胚乳為濕法製造的副產品，進一步加工為植物油與蛋白飼料，並製造檸檬酸用於食品與工業用途。Carbohydrate Solutions 業務單位也推進碳捕捉與封存及其他減排計畫，使業務能支持低碳運作與植物基材料取代化石衍生材料的成長應用。
本公司持有以下企業的權益，這些企業從事的活動屬於 Carbohydrate Solutions 業務單位：Hungrana Ltd、Almidones Mexicanos S.A. de CV、Aston Foods and Food Ingredients、Red Star Yeast Company, LLC 以及 LSCP, LLC。

Nutrition 業務單位服務於多種最終市場，包括人類的食品、飲料與營養補充品，以及牲畜、養殖業與寵物的完整飼料、飼料預混料與添加劑、寵物食品與寵物零食。該業務單位從事廣泛的原料與解決方案的創造、製造、銷售與分銷，包括植物基蛋白、來自天然的風味與顏色、風味系統、乳化劑、可溶性纖維、多元醇、水膠體、益生菌、益生元、後生元、酵素、植物提取物及其他專用食品與飼料原料與系統。Nutrition 業務單位也包含與可食用豆類的採購、加工與分銷相關的活動，以及配方飼料與動物健康與營養產品的加工與分銷，以及合同與自有品牌寵物零食與食品的製造。
本公司持有以下企業的權益，這些企業從事的活動屬於 Nutrition 業務單位：Vimison S.A. de C.V.、Vitafort ZRT、Dusial S.A.、Novial SAS、ADM Matsutani LLC 以及 Matsutani Singapore Pte. Ltd。
Corporate 包含 ADM Ventures 在早期階段創業公司中的成本法與權益法投資活動。除了識別投資公司外，ADM Ventures 還參與部分高潛力、新產品開發專案與替代商業模式，目標在於支持本公司戰略目標。
Other Business 包含本公司如下列所述的其他運營活動。

paragraphs: 本管理層討論與分析（MD&A）應與附屬之合併財務報表一併閱讀，該財務報表可於第二部分第8項「財務報表與補充資料」中找到。
本MD&A一般討論2025年與2024年的項目及2025年與2024年之間的年對年比較。關於2023年的項目及2024年與2023年之間的年對年比較，未包含於本10-K申報表中，可於本公司2024年財務年度（截至2024年12月31日）的10-K年度報告「管理層討論與分析（MD&A）」中找到，該報告於2025年2月20日提交。
Archer-Daniels-Midland Company及其子公司（本公司或ADM）解讀自然的力量，以提升生活品質。本公司為全球農業供應鏈的重要管理者與加工商，透過連結地方需求與全球能力，提供糧食安全。ADM同時也是人與動物營養的重要供應商，並在健康與 wellness 產品領域佔領領導地位。
本公司的營運為三個應報告分部所組織、管理與歸類：農業服務與油籽、碳水化合物解決方案、營養。本公司的其他營運不屬於應報告分部，根據適用的會計準則歸類於企業本部或其他業務。詳見第二部分第8項「財務報表與補充資料」。附註17「分部與地理資訊」以取得更多關於本公司業務性質與應報告分部的資訊。
本公司目標為持續為股東與客戶建立並維持長期價值。本公司已建立以下優先事項以協助達成此目標：
• 聚焦執行與成本管理 – ADM致力於優先考量營運卓越，並透過以下方式推動目標成本削減：(1) 提升工廠效率；(2) 在營養分部內優化營運槓桿；(3) 減少第三方支出與營銷、一般及行政費用。
• 戰略簡化 – ADM致力於透過執行簡化機會的管道，提高投入資本的回報，包括：(1) 解決表現、需求與容量挑戰；(2) 減少不符合本公司回報目標的資本支出；(3) 透過協同效益、關閉與出售，減少能力重疊。
• 有針對性的成長投資 – ADM致力於優先考量在關鍵戰略計畫上的內生投資，同時確保業務為未來做好準備，包括：(1) 工廠現代化投資；(2) 成本優化投資；(3) 企業系統與流程提升。
• 精準運用資本 – ADM 會謹慎投資於有潛力的機會，同時持續透過股息回饋股東價值。
成功落實上述優先事項，預期將使 ADM 有能力繼續投資未來的成長機會，創造長期價值。ADM 正投資於多個關鍵領域，例如增強營養、生物素、生物解決方案、精準發酵以及減碳。這些發展路徑各有不同的成長特徵與價值創造時間表，且每項皆與本公司核心業務相互補充，並具有創造強勁且持續回報的潛力。
ARCHER-DANIELS-MIDLAND COMPANY 管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析
ADM 已調整其數位策略，並轉向優先執行區域性、更具彈性的專案，而非大型全球性實施。本公司正在加速數據旅程，同時持續投資於網路安全與網路及應用程式韌性。基於此策略調整，於 2025 年 12 月 31 日會計年度結束時，本公司確認了與先前資本化內部使用軟體相關的減損費用計 1.79 億美元。請參閱第二部分，第 8 項「財務報表與補充資料」。第 18 註：資產減損、退出及重整費用。
在超過 120 年的時間裡，ADM 一直都是以農業、創新與負責任的管理為基礎來發展業務。今日，永續性已成為 ADM 成長策略的核心驅動力，推動創新、提升韌性，並在全世界糧食系統中釋放新的價值。ADM 將作物轉化為廣泛產品的過程，依賴健康的土壤、水與空氣，而當本公司展望未來時，正推動努力以支持與協助農業與農民，推動創新與長期價值，並保護與強化關鍵的供應鏈。
ADM 聚焦於與農民合作，擴大永續實踐，透過工具、見解與財務誘因協助農民的營運表現。ADM 正創新以應對對永續來源、生物基產品日益增長的需求，為那些提供健康、透明與環境效益的作物農民創造新的市場機會。本公司正現代化自身營運，以提高效率、增強競爭力、減少排放，並協助建立更韌性的供應鏈。

headings: 本公司面臨潛在的業務中斷風險，此等風險可能不利於本公司營運成果，並可能導致費用及負債增加。
運輸、通貨膨脹影響及能源價格波動可能影響本公司營運成果。
人力資源的可得性可能不足以有效支撐全球營運。
本公司可能無法實現戰略優先事項的效益，或在執行這些戰略優先事項時遭遇延遲。
本公司面臨與健康疫情、大流行病及類似疫情相關的風險。
本公司面臨與國際衝突、恐怖攻擊、戰爭、其他地緣政治事件，例如俄羅斯與烏克蘭衝突、海上盜賊活動及其他經濟動盪相關的風險。
地緣政治風險可能幹擾全球市場，並對本公司的業務與財務結果產生負面影響。
本公司面臨各種與ESG相關的演進規範，這些規範會影響本公司的業務與策略，並可能對其聲譽、業務及營運結果產生不利影響。
本公司在ESG相關事項及永續實踐方面的目標與股東期待，可能使本公司面臨更高的成本、聲譽損害及其他風險。
對外部融資的取得限制可能因本公司的資本密集性而對其營運結果產生不利影響。
本公司面臨與全球及區域經濟衰退相關的風險，這些風險可能對本公司的營運結果產生不利影響。
本公司在營運所處市場面臨激烈競爭，且受產業特定風險影響，這些風險可能對本公司營運成果產生不利影響。
本公司風險管理策略可能無法達到預期效果。
本公司在全球面臨眾多法律、法規及政策要求，這些要求可能對本公司營運成果及未來策略產生不利影響。
稅法變更或面臨額外稅務負擔，可能對本公司財務狀況及營運成果產生重大影響。
本公司若無法成功升級資訊及營運科技系統，可能對本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果產生重大且不利影響。
資訊及營運科技系統可能遭遇中斷或故障，可能影響本公司執行業務的能力。
本公司之系統、流程及場地可能遭遇網路安全及其他事件，此等事件可能使本公司面臨營運及各類監管風險。
本公司涉及與使用人工智慧及其他新興數位科技相關之技術、法律及機會相關風險。
本公司參與多項法律程序，該等程序可能導致不利之結果。
過去及未來可能出現負面宣傳，可能對本公司及其普通股市場價格產生不利影響。
paragraphs: 下列所描述的風險，以及本年度報告書（Form 10-K）中包含的其他資訊，應謹慎考量。任何一項或數項風險都可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運結果及股票價格造成重大且不利的影響，並可能導致實際營運結果與財務狀況與過去或預期未來的營運結果與財務狀況有重大差異。此外，尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前本公司尚未知悉或認為不重要，也可能對本公司造成不利影響。

本公司在多個市場與地理區域從事製造與分銷活動。因此，本公司面臨這些活動內在的風險，並有時會因各種事件與外部因素而遭遇未預期的停機或廣泛的財產損壞與營運中斷，其中一些因素超出本公司控制範圍。這些事件與因素包括，但不限於設備故障、原材料短缺、自然災害、惡劣天氣條件、事故、爆炸、火災、環境事件、罷工或其他勞工或產業爭議、戰爭或恐怖襲擊、網路安全攻擊或其他未預期的中斷。這些事件可能導致人員受傷、生命損失與環境損害。在某些情況下，本公司依賴單一工廠或設施在特定地理區域製造或處理某些產品，或以其他方式進行。本公司可能無法及時有效地解決中斷，而這些風險所導致的相關責任可能無法完全被保險覆蓋，或超過保險責任範圍，且任何保險賠償可能在事件發生數年後才收到。這些事件與因素的影響已並可能在未來需要大量投資與支出以修復受損的設施或設備，並需要管理層的關注與其他資源，這已並可能對本公司營運結果造成不利影響。

本公司營運依賴可靠且高效的運輸服務，若運輸服務中斷，可能導致供應材料至本公司設施的困難，並影響本公司及時交付產品至客戶的能力。本公司依賴可航行的河流與水道以更有效地履行運輸義務。此外，若某些非農產品原材料，例如水或本公司加工運作中使用的特定化學品無法取得，則可能影響本公司業務。任何重大缺乏可用於某些本公司加工運作的水，都可能對營運結果造成重大且不利的影響。影響非農產品原材料可取得的某些因素，可能超出本公司控制範圍，包括但不限於因天氣、水位高低、經濟條件、邊境關閉、供應商製造延誤或中斷、材料短缺、能源供應中斷，以及供應商信用條件不足或不佳。
本公司營運成本與某些成品的銷售價格對能源價格變動、通貨膨脹壓力與某些物流限制具有敏感性。本公司加工廠主要使用電力、天然氣與煤炭供應。本公司運輸業務部分依賴鐵路運輸、柴油燃料及其他石油產品，以及海洋運輸與港口運作的可取得性與成本。這些物品的成本或可取得性大幅增加，包括任何通貨膨脹影響、溫室氣體的管制或課稅，已並可能在未來對本公司生產成本與營運結果造成重大且不利的影響。
ADM 的全球運營依賴於處理、倉儲及運送用於其他製造領域或作為第三方客戶輸入或產品的原材料的專業人員。專業技工與生產工人的可取得性一直是製造業的重點關注領域。因合格資源有限而無法正確配置製造設施的專業技工與時薪勞工，可能對運營造成負面影響。

作為其整體戰略的一部分，本公司專注於營運卓越與推動目標成本削減。本公司已實施計畫以改善製造與生產設施的表現，提高營養部門的營運槓桿，並削減第三方支出與銷售、總務及行政費用。這些計畫與未來相關計畫的成功，取決於廣泛的各種因素。本公司改善成本結構的能力，取決於降低製造、配送與行政成本，以及擁有成本效益良好的原材料、能源與相關製造需求的採購計畫，所有這些都面臨風險與不確定性，且未必成功。本公司營運資金需求直接受全球商品價格影響，而這些價格可能大幅波動且變化迅速。這些計畫的實施可能比預期更困難、成本更高或耗時更久，且可能無法實現任何或全部預期的效益，這可能對本公司業務、營運結果與財務狀況造成不利影響。
